title: gHAWK: Structural Encoding for Scalable Training of Graph Neural Networks on Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2512.08274v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are a rich source of structured data, and graph neural networks (GNNs) are the dominant tool for learning over them. However, existing message-passing GNNs struggle to scale to large KGs because they rely on the iterative message passing process to learn graph structure. This process is inefficient, especially under mini-batch training, where a node sees only a partial view of its neighborhood. In this paper, we address this problem and present gHAWK, a novel and scalable GNN training framework for large KGs. The key idea is to precompute structural features for each node that capture its local and global structure before GNN training even begins. Specifically, gHAWK introduces a preprocessing step that computes: (a) Bloom filters to compactly encode local neighborhood structure, and (b) TransE embeddings to represent each node's global position in the graph. translated_title: gHAWK：面向知识图谱上图神经网络可扩展训练的结构编码
translated_abstract: 知识图谱是结构化数据的丰富来源，而图神经网络是在其上进行学习的主要工具。然而，现有的消息传递式图神经网络难以扩展到大规模知识图谱，因为它们依赖于迭代式的消息传递过程来学习图结构。这一过程效率低下，尤其是在小批量训练场景下，每个节点只能看到其邻域的部分视图。在本文中，我们针对这一问题提出了gHAWK，这是一种新颖且可扩展的大规模知识图谱GNN训练框架。其核心思想是在GNN训练开始之前，预先为每个节点计算能够捕捉其局部和全局结构的结构特征。具体而言，gHAWK引入了一个预处理步骤，用于计算：(a) 布隆过滤器，以紧凑的方式编码局部邻域结构；(b) TransE嵌入，以表示每个节点在图中的全局位置。随后，这些特征可与任何领域特定的特征进行融合。
tldr: gHAWK通过在训练前预计算布隆过滤器（编码局部邻域结构）和TransE嵌入（表示全局位置）作为节点的结构特征并与领域特征融合，提出了一种可扩展的大规模知识图谱GNN训练框架，克服了传统消息传递式GNN在大规模图上的扩展性瓶颈。
en_tdlr: gHAWK is a scalable GNN training framework for large knowledge graphs that precomputes structural features—Bloom filters for compact local neighborhood encoding and TransE embeddings for global node position—before training, overcoming the scalability limitations of iterative message-passing GNNs.
